labels: enhancement, module-proposal

**What discipline does it encode?**
<!-- The one-line job. e.g. "force enumeration of degenerate cases before a proof is declared complete." -->

**Skill or agent?**
- [ ] Skill (a playbook the model follows)
- [ ] Agent (a co-math sub-agent with tools and a workstream)

**When would it be invoked?**
<!-- Trigger phrases / the situation it's for. -->

**How does it uphold "no hand-waving"?**
<!-- How does it make the model more correct, not just more confident? What's its honest failure mode? -->

**Does it need anything external?**
<!-- A CLI, a toolchain (Lean, Codex), a library? Or self-contained? -->

**Are you up for building it?**
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to own this module
- [ ] I'm proposing it for someone else to pick up

<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md for the module contract before you start. -->
